title: 1,4-Benzo[b]dithiine Derivatives Accessed via Ring Expansion of 1,3-Dithioles
content: Herein, we disclose an efficient route to the synthesis of brominated 1,4-benzo[b]dithiine derivatives via ring expansion of aromatic 1,3-dithiole promoted by bromine (51% - 94%). The use of a methyl-substituent on aromatic ring lead to formation of an inseparable, equimolar mixture of regioisomers. Additionally, 4-methoxyacetophenone derivative yielded unprecedented dimeric products, which structure was confirmed by single crystal X-ray crystallography. We propose a reaction mechanism, rationalizing the formation of regioisomers originating.
